control_no_exact_ties_untouched.note: structurally guaranteed -- every variant fn only ever iterates tied_groups, which is empty here

negative_controls.control_admission_count_per_tie_bar: at most ONE real ALLOW ever occurs per tie-bar (LIMIT_MAX_PER_SYMBOL enforces this) -- 'all tied candidates admitted simultaneously' is architecturally impossible for this single-slot symbol, not an untested scenario
